cleanupRule: owned start_new_session process group receives bounded TERM then KILL; ProcessLookupError is recorded as nonfatal groupMissing only when exit/drain are durable
argvRule: xcrun mode preserves ['/usr/bin/xcrun','swiftc'] logical argv while real resolved compiler path/hash are recorded separately; direct mode preserves logical symlink argv[0] without resolve substitution
sourceRule: exact Witness.swift and CaptureHost.swift pre/post path/hash/bytes must match
successRule: SUCCESS requires exitCode 0, no timeout, no source/tool drift, durable stdout/stderr & emitted binary hash
